accuracy.basis: this building's own meters, predicting a held-out year
accuracy.cooling_note: cooling is validated less well than heating (building features barely beat the median)

signed_error_quantiles.definition: prediction / actual - 1; signed, positive means overprediction
signed_error_quantiles.band_note: For error = prediction/actual - 1, actual bounds invert and reverse the error quantiles. These are empirical total-meter errors, not calibrated H+C-only prediction intervals.

commitments.title: Turn the heat down at night and when you're out
commitments.grh_item: Use a Programmable Thermostat (2) + Use an ENERGY STAR Certified Smart Thermostat (2)
commitments.note: Never set the heat below 64°F (18°C) while anyone is home, asleep included: the World Health Organization's health-based minimum indoor temperature for cold seasons (keep it warmer for babies, older adults and anyone unwell).

commitments.title: Send your landlord the drafted email: add storm windows or double-pane windows
commitments.cost_note: Low-e storm windows cost $60-$200 per window installed (DOE Energy Saver). DTE pays $15 per replacement window in homes it heats (2026).

commitments.title: Seal drafts (renters: weatherstrip windows and doors)
commitments.cost_note: Rebate: A2ZERO air sealing $500 ($1,000 income-qualified), plus a $1,500 bonus with two insulation measures.

commitments.title: Insulate the attic to R-50
commitments.grh_item: Attic or Non-attic Roof Areas are Insulated
commitments.cost_note: Rebate: A2ZERO attic insulation $500 ($1,000 income-qualified). DTE pays $600 for 500+ sq ft of attic in DTE-heated homes of up to 2 units (2026).

commitments.title: Insulate the walls
commitments.cost_note: Rebate: A2ZERO above-grade wall insulation $500 ($1,000 income-qualified), 250+ sq ft, contractor-installed.

commitments.title: Add storm windows or double-pane windows
commitments.cost_note: Low-e storm windows cost $60-$200 per window installed (DOE Energy Saver). DTE pays $15 per replacement window in homes it heats (2026).

commitments.title: Switch to a cold-climate heat pump
commitments.grh_item: Electricity is the Primary Type of Energy Used for Space Heating (15) + Medium-Efficiency Cold-Climate Heat Pump with Electric Backup Heat (20)
commitments.cost_note: Midpoint of $11,300-$19,500, where most Midwest heat pump retrofits fall (DOE/LBNL, Dec 2024). Rebate: A2ZERO cold-climate heat pump $4,000 ($5,500 income-qualified). The federal 25C tax credit ended Dec 31, 2025.
